entries.claim: Claude Projects are self-contained workspaces with their own chat history and knowledge base, available on all plans including Free, which is capped at five projects.
entries.source_quote_he: Projects are available to all users, including those with free Claude accounts. Free users can create a maximum of five projects.

entries.claim: Claude Pro is $17/month billed annually or $20 billed monthly; Max starts at $100/month.
entries.source_quote_he: Per month with annual subscription discount ($200 billed up front). $20 if billed monthly.

entries.claim: Google AI Pro is priced at ₪74.90/month in Israel (not ₪97.90), with Google AI Plus at ₪19/month below it.
Israel VAT rate is 18%, effective 1 January 2025 (previously 17%), and unchanged in 2026.
entries.source_quote_he: סכום המע״מ מחושב בשיעור קבוע ממחיר העסקה או הסחורה, והחל מיום 01.01.2025 הוא עומד על 18% ממחיר הרכישה או השירות. עד 31.12.2024 היה שיעור המע"מ 17%

entries.claim: n8n ships a standard self-hosted Community Edition on GitHub, which is the free route.
entries.source_quote_he: A standard, self-hosted version of n8n is available on GitHub.

entries.claim: Gemini Gems still exist under that name and are created from the Gemini interface.

Claude consumer plans (Free, Pro, Max) carry a model-improvement setting the user must choose; allowing it extends retention to five years, declining keeps the 30-day period. Commercial tiers are excluded.
entries.source_quote_he: We are also expanding our data retention period to five years if you allow us to use your data for model improvement, with this setting only applying to new or resumed chats and coding sessions. If you don't choose this option, you will continue with our existing 30-day data retention period.

entries.claim: The Anthropic consumer-terms change applies to Free, Pro and Max and not to Commercial Terms services.
entries.source_quote_he: These updates apply to users on our Claude Free, Pro, and Max plans, including when they use Claude Code from accounts associated with those plans.

entries.claim: OpenAI removed the ability to create and publish new custom GPTs from personal ChatGPT accounts including Plus and Pro, while keeping it for Business, Enterprise and Edu workspaces.
entries.source_quote_he: I’m extremely disappointed with OpenAI’s decision to remove the ability to create and publish new custom GPTs from personal ChatGPT accounts, including Plus and Pro, while keeping GPT creation available for Business, Enterprise, and Edu
entries.note: OpenAI help centre is Cloudflare-blocked to automated fetch; verified against the OpenAI Developer Community thread and corroborated by independent reporting.

entries.claim: Google AI Plus is ₪19/month in Israel, below Google AI Pro.
Amendment 13 requires reporting a material breach to the Privacy Protection Authority within 72 hours of discovery.
entries.source_quote_he: חובת דיווח לרשות להגנת הפרטיות תוך 72 שעות מגילוי פרצה מהותית

entries.claim: The Privacy Protection Authority has begun imposing administrative fines under Amendment 13; the first was ₪256,000 on the Meuhedet health fund for failing to report a serious security event promptly.
entries.source_quote_he: לראשונה מאז כניסת תיקון 13 לתוקף, הרשות להגנת הפרטיות הטילה עיצום כספי בסך של 256,000 ש"ח (לאחר הפחתות בהתאם להוראות החוק)

entries.claim: Google AI Ultra starts at ₪390/month in Israel, giving 5x the usage limits of AI Pro.
